keyword_evidence: SERP_ONLY: public marketplace/category results show personalized classroom rugs, custom teacher-name mats, calming corner rugs, classroom jobs/rules designs, and SEL/emotional-regulation classroom decor. No paid volume or first-party search data used.
buyer_summary: Buyer intent is a hypothesis from product evidence plus category SERP language: teachers want personalized classroom rugs that make routines, rules, emotional regulation, jobs, voice levels, or affirmation zones visible and kid-friendly.
purchase_concerns: Teacher-name accuracy, classroom wording readability, age fit for preschool/kindergarten/elementary students, size fit, material feel, backing grip, machine-washable or cleaning expectations, reinforced edges, and whether the educational prompt matches the teacher's classroom system.
